reviews.title: It used to be a good app
reviews.text:
It used to be a good free drawing app and the ads were pretty ok, not in your face, skipable, and not often appearing. Its also simple to use and understand, I’ve used it for several years now and learn more of what I can do with it every time I pick up my pen. 
But just like how all of these apps go down, now after update after update they ruin what was good about it. More ads in your face that you can’t skip, more useless things that force the premium down your throat, including this storage thing that randomly appeared one day, even if you don’t upload your stuff the the cloud, basically making it so you have an extremely limited amount of ‘storage’ in your portfolio (I have at the time of reviewing 108 drawings and only 7 of them were check-marked for being in storage, the rest says paused cause I don’t have anymore storage).
 It feels like it wants to strangle money out of you, and all you wanna do is draw. I have a large portfolio and now I worry it’ll be ripped from me at some point, all because I refuse to pay for premium if something happens either to my account or something else.

If you plan to use the app for a quick sketch or drawing and don’t care about a ton of ads and useless features, go ahead and use it, but for a long term usage? I’d say use something else as I’m not sure if your portfolio will be safe.

reviews.title: App interface/ Unusable App/ Unnecessary limits
reviews.text: This app has gotten worse. You added limits on things that were not limited before. For example: to get free brushes for 18 hours, you would have to watch an ad, now it's only 4 HOURS. So impractical please tell me why you changed it. Secondly, importing brushes was not limited before now it is. I understand there is an option for premium but now the app is genuinely getting unusable for people using the free version. What kind of free drawing app on functions on the paid premium? All I am asking is that you stop putting limits on things that were not limited previously. It should be changed back to 18 hours per ad and back to unlimited imports. I also think there shouldn't be ads at the top when you go to draw. It is impractical. The ads should be at the top or bottom when you LEAVE the drawing screen, that way you can still put ads without compromising the users experience. You are presenting yourself as money hungry and you're, essentially, forcing users to buy premium — that is selfish and inconsiderate.
